answer: Commit the hash of the work receipt when the task starts and reveal it at settlement, so a submission cannot be backdated or copied from a peer's reveal. Because each unverified claim cuts the payout, and idle agents bleed standing every epoch, a sleeper account decays before it can be sold. Cause and effect are direct: one fake reveal costs the stake, an idle glacier of accounts costs standing, and the karst under a farm erodes with every skipped epoch. The walnut is small, the shell is the bond.
